title: INC-24011 elevated checkout p99
text: 2024-03-12 INC-24011. Symptom: checkout p99 above 2.5s in EU for 40 minutes. Cause: shard-b GC stall. Decision: fail over EU checkout to shard-d and keep shard-b drained until GC flags rolled back. Do not raise timeouts. Ticket closed as 'failover-first, no timeout bump'.

title: INC-24077 payment webhook retries
text: 2024-06-02 INC-24077. Symptom: duplicate captures. Cause: webhook retries without idempotency keys. Decision: add idempotency keys on the processor adapter; do not disable webhooks. Precedent for any duplicate-capture report.

title: INC-24105 Saturday pager storm
text: 2024-08-17 INC-24105. Symptom: 30 Sev-2 pages, all shard-b. Decision: page storm is still Sev-2 until checkout error rate exceeds 5 percent; do not auto-promote to Sev-1. Commander remains Saturday primary.

title: INC-25002 freeze-week latency
text: 2025-12-22 INC-25002. Symptom: EU checkout p99 2.8s during change freeze. Decision: use sev2-mitigation to drain shard-b following INC-24011; schema freeze still holds. Documented as the freeze-week checkout precedent.

title: INC-23901 lab freezer near-miss
text: 2023-11-04 INC-23901. F-2 warmed to -58 C. Decision: samples stayed in F-2; MOVE-7 was drafted but not signed because Facilities cleared in 12 minutes. Incoming samples used COC-3. Precedent: do not move samples during a short alarm.
